gbfs.coverage_note: Only observed collections; TTL gaps and stale station states are unknown, never interpolated into availability or historical trips.

execution_context.measurement_caveat: First execution included failed attempts and cached recovery; there is no clean cold end-to-end benchmark. Worker attempts, base phases and publication are measured separately. Object seconds include cached verifications and repeat receipts; do not sum receipts as download wall time. OS peak RSS is per process, not aggregate concurrent RAM or DuckDB limit. Disk totals include retained attempts, not minimal disk needs.

runs.measurement_scope: Whole unchanged CLI including uv startup, cached source preparation checks and publication verification; first cold CLI total not measured
runs.resource_note: RSS is measured separately in worker/publication records, not by this shell timer

train_serve_availability: No weather/forecast data or historical GBFS before collection. Source Last-Modified can represent a reissue; first-publication availability is unknown. F4 not implemented.
interpretation: Raw/canonical profiles precede cross-source exclusions; monthly final dispositions and partitions reflect the published global decisions. No duration/geography outlier removal.

rules_evidence_impact_tests.impact: Station/route coverage differs from ride count
rules_evidence_impact_tests.rule: Keep eligible rides; null stations excluded only from relevant event metrics

rules_evidence_impact_tests.impact: Double counting or ambiguous ride identity
rules_evidence_impact_tests.rule: Exact payload: earliest eligible month/file/row; conflicts quarantine every variant

evidence.note: Reason flags overlap; they are not additive row exclusions.

rules_evidence_impact_tests.impact: Wrong UTC hour or invalid event order
rules_evidence_impact_tests.rule: Reject ambiguous/gap/invalid/negative/future; retain flagged real duration peaks

rules_evidence_impact_tests.impact: Unknown availability and unsafe historical join
rules_evidence_impact_tests.rule: Stale/missing stay explicit; station history begins only at confirmed receipt and expires by source ttl

privacy: Aggregate evidence only; raw trips, GBFS payloads and Parquet remain local and ignored by Git.
